name: Bit Pi
author: Bit Apps

sections.description:
⚠️⚠️⚠️ Disclaimer: This is a beta version of this plugin. Please, inform us if you find any kind of bug/issue ⚠️⚠️⚠️

Bit Pi allows you to connect different platforms and automate tasks within WordPress.

📢 Join our new community Bit Pi & get updates of our new plugin.

Bit Apps

API Usage

Bit Pi is a powerful integration tool that uses platform API to send and receive data with users’ permission.
some operations are done in the frontend(Javascript) and some are done in the backend(PHP). Bit Pi did not collect any integration data from users.
But collect errors, logs, and usage data to improve the plugin.
currently, we are using the following platforms API.

Google Sheets API
We are using the REST APIs to interact programmatically with Google Sheets. View documentation

Google API Services Terms & Policy

Google Drive API
We are using the REST APIs to interact programmatically with Google Drive. View documentation

Google API Services Terms & Policy

Google Calendar API
We are using the REST APIs to interact programmatically with Google Calendar. View documentation

Google API Services Terms & Policy

Jot Form API
The Jotform API is written for Jotform users and 3rd party developers who would like to serve Jotform users. View documentation

Jot Form Terms & Policy

Zoho CRM API
Integrate the Zoho CRM modules with any third-party application. View documentation

Zoho CRM API Terms & Policy

Privacy Policy

Bit Pi did not collect any integration data from users without user consent.
On the plugin support page, we have info about this product and other products we developed and also have links to support and privacy policy of this product, which are loaded from our server.

Development and Contribution

Bit Pi free versions codes are Open Source and available in GitHub.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin.
  2. From the WordPress Admin Panel, click on Plugins => Add New.
  3. Click on Upload, so you can directly upload your plugin zip file.
  4. Use the browse button to select the downloaded plugin zip file, and then click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click “Activate”.
